system.description:
You create an illusory mirage of wolves that follow you as a pack and aid or hinder any creature of your choice when commanded.

Roll Six d20’s, recording the results. For this jutsu’s duration, whenever a creature in this jutsu’s radius rolls a d20 on their turn, you can replace their d20’s result with the result of one of your d20’s.
